integrity: All-size sign-reversal, potential, congruence-counting, and extremal-spread arguments supplied. Exact standalone code directly tests the vertexwise update on 379706 normalized profiles for graph sizes 2 through 9 and probes 324504 additional profiles beyond the claimed recurrence boundary. Self-review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Integer-valued simultaneous diffusion on labelled simple complete graphs; periodic-state and temporal two-cycle counts at each conserved total only. No transient census or large-size asymptotics; negative coordinates are permitted. Finite checks do not replace the all-size proof. Historical equivalent enumerators remain possible.
title: Exact energy-residue two-cycle census for integer diffusion on cliques
